q: The prime minister _____ any idea of changing the system.
translation: 首相对任何改变体制的想法都不予考虑。

q: He faced _____ after rejection before finding a job.
translation: 他在找到工作之前遭遇了一次又一次的拒绝。

q: I am an American, not by accident of birth but by _____.
translation: 我是美国人，并非出于出生的偶然，而是出于自己的选择。

q: I bumped into her quite by _____ in Oxford Street.
translation: 我在牛津街偶然遇见了她。

q: The news _____ shows updates about what your friends are doing.
explain: feed n. （信息或新闻的）推送流。
translation: 新闻信息流显示你的朋友们正在做什么的更新。

q: The children _____ the ducks on the pond yesterday.
translation: 孩子们昨天在池塘边喂鸭子。

q: Six case study participants were selected for _____ investigation.
explain: in-depth adj. 深入的；详尽的。
translation: 六名案例研究参与者被选中进行深入调查。

q: A government spokesperson made a _____ to the press.
translation: 一位政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

q: He was in a _____ of permanent depression.
translation: 他处于一种长期的消沉状态。

q: He has already _____ his intention to run for election.
translation: 他已经表明了自己参加竞选的意思。

q: The _____ government has promised more money for local schools.
translation: 州政府承诺为当地学校提供更多资金。

q: The bishop said these crimes were a _____ of a moral decline in society.
translation: 主教说这些罪行是社会道德沦丧的一个征兆。

q: All the pressure _____ up and he was off work for weeks with stress.
explain: build v. 积聚；逐步增强（build up）。
translation: 所有压力积聚起来，他因压力而停工数周。

q: He has a strong _____ and broad shoulders.
translation: 他体格强壮，肩膀宽阔。

q: All the shopping had _____ out of my bag.
explain: spill v. 溢出；洒出（spill out）。
translation: 买的东西全都从我的包里掉了出来。

q: The _____ of snow and ice soon led to the formation of a huge ice cap.
translation: 冰雪的积累很快导致了巨大冰盖的形成。

q: The police have been _____ evidence of his guilt.
translation: 警方一直在收集他有罪的证据。

q: Alcohol should only ever be consumed in _____.
translation: 酒精只应适度饮用。

q: The cabin is of _____ size, just right for a small family.
explain: moderate adj. 中等的；适度的。
translation: 这间小屋中等大小，正好适合一个小家庭。

q: Writing about feelings can _____ the link between stress and poor health.
translation: 书写感受可以缓和压力与健康不佳之间的联系。

q: What I am saying _____ only to some of you.
explain: apply v. 适用；适用于（apply to）。
translation: 我所说的话只适用于你们中的一些人。

q: The study of science has _____ all of our lives.
translation: 科学研究丰富了我们的全部生活。

q: The experience of learning a language is _____ in itself.
explain: enriching adj. 使人充实的；丰富人生的。
translation: 学习一门语言的经历本身就是充实人的。

q: Most breakfast cereals are _____ with extra vitamins.
explain: enriched adj. 添加了营养成分的；强化的。
translation: 大多数早餐麦片都添加了额外的维生素。

q: He _____ himself with a quick, cool shower.
explain: refresh v. 使恢复精力；使提神。
translation: 他冲了个凉爽的快澡来提神。

q: It's _____ to hear somebody speaking common sense.
explain: refreshing adj. 令人耳目一新的；提神的。
translation: 听到有人讲常识令人耳目一新。

q: I feel so _____ after that cup of tea.
explain: refreshed adj. 精力恢复的；神清气爽的。
translation: 喝了那杯茶后我感到神清气爽。

q: I have a hectic _____ for the next few days.
explain: schedule n. 日程安排；时间表。
translation: 接下来几天我的日程安排非常繁忙。

q: The important meeting is _____ for Friday afternoon.
translation: 重要会议定于周五下午举行。

q: The United States has _____ a historic deal with India.
explain: strike v. 达成（strike a deal）。
translation: 美国与印度达成了一项历史性协议。

q: The _____ lasted for three weeks and closed the factory.
translation: 罢工持续了三周，导致工厂关闭。

q: The leaves were slowly falling to the _____ on that cold morning.
translation: 那个寒冷的早晨，树叶正慢慢落向地面。

q: All planes out of Heathrow have been _____ by the strikes.
explain: ground v. 使停飞，使搁浅；禁止（孩子）外出。
translation: 希思罗机场的所有飞机都因罢工而停飞了。

q: Simmons says that her family keeps her _____ when life gets busy.
explain: grounded adj. 脚踏实地的，理智的。
translation: 西蒙斯说，生活忙碌时，家人让她保持脚踏实地。

q: Some insects are becoming _____ to the common chemicals used by farmers.
explain: resistant adj. 有抵抗力的，抵抗的。
translation: 一些昆虫正在对农民使用的常见化学药剂产生抗药性。

q: Keep your purse in a safe _____ when you are traveling.
explain: place n. 地方，场所；位置。
translation: 旅行时要把钱包放在安全的地方。

q: He _____ the letter in a drawer and locked it.
translation: 他把信放进抽屉里，然后锁上了。

q: Volunteering can add _____ to your life and make you feel happier.
translation: 做志愿者能为你的生活增添意义，让你感到更快乐。

q: _____, the plan should work, but we still need to test it.
translation: 理论上，这个计划应该可行，但我们仍需测试。

q: The course gives students a _____ basis for later study.
translation: 这门课程为学生以后的学习提供了理论基础。

q: According to the _____, the universe began with a huge explosion.
translation: 根据这一理论，宇宙始于一次巨大的爆炸。

q: It takes a lot of _____ to play the violin well.
translation: 要把小提琴拉好需要大量练习。

q: She diligently _____ her violin every day before the competition.
translation: 比赛前，她每天都刻苦练习小提琴。

q: He offered her some _____ advice about finding a job.
explain: practical adj. 实用的，实际的。
translation: 他给了她一些关于找工作的实用建议。

q: The theater was _____ empty when we arrived.
translation: 我们到达时，剧院几乎空无一人。

q: The two brothers are almost _____ and do everything together.
explain: inseparable adj. 不可分离的，形影不离的。
translation: 这两兄弟几乎形影不离，做什么都在一起。

q: Newspaper editors all _____ to be first with a big story.
translation: 报纸编辑都努力抢先报道重大新闻。

q: Money was the most important _____ in his decision to leave.
translation: 钱是他决定离开的最重要因素。

q: The strength and _____ of the economic recovery is still in doubt.
translation: 经济复苏的力度和可持续性仍不确定。

q: The love and support of his family _____ him during his time in prison.
translation: 在狱中那段日子里，家人的爱与支持支撑着他。

q: This type of farming is simply not _____ any more.
translation: 这种耕作方式再也无法持续下去了。

q: Good written communication is essential in ensuring _____ of patient care.
translation: 良好的书面沟通对于确保病人护理的连续性至关重要。

q: He was _____ at dawn by the sound of crying.
translation: 黎明时，他被哭声唤醒。

q: I was still _____ when he came to bed last night.
translation: 昨晚他上床睡觉时，我还醒着。

q: She _____ from a deep sleep and looked around the room.
translation: 她从沉睡中醒来，环顾房间。

q: The film crew got some amazing pictures from their small _____.
translation: 摄制组用他们的小型无人机拍到了一些精彩的画面。

q: A plane was _____ in the distance all afternoon.
translation: 整个下午，远处一直有一架飞机在嗡嗡作响。

q: The fuel tank has a _____ of forty liters, which is enough for long trips.
explain: capacity n. 容量；容纳能力。
translation: 这个油箱的容量是四十升，足够长途旅行使用。

q: The house had _____ been an inn before the family moved in.
translation: 这栋房子在这家人搬进来之前曾是一家小旅馆。

q: He was unable to give a _____ explanation for why he was late.
explain: credible adj. 可信的，可靠的。
translation: 他无法为自己的迟到给出一个可信的解释。

q: We bought the dishwasher on _____ and paid for it over six months.
translation: 我们赊购了那台洗碗机，在六个月内付清了款项。

q: The company is _____ with inventing the first practical industrial robot.
explain: credit v. 把……归于；认为……有（某种品质或成就）。
translation: 这家公司被认为发明了第一台实用的工业机器人。

q: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely _____.
explain: incredible adj. 极好的；惊人的。
translation: 从山顶看到的景色简直令人惊叹。

q: A free media is essential for an _____ democracy to function properly.
explain: informed adj. 有知识的；了解情况的。
translation: 自由的媒体对于知情民主的正常运转至关重要。

q: The team has lost the last two games, and to make _____ worse, their captain is injured.
translation: 球队输掉了最近两场比赛，更糟的是，队长还受伤了。

q: Does it _____ if I bring my own car to the meeting?
translation: 我开自己的车去开会要紧吗？

q: The artist had _____ her lying on a bed in a quiet room.
translation: 画家描绘了她躺在一个安静房间里的床上。

q: She _____ down to pick up the coins that had fallen on the floor.
translation: 她弯下腰去捡掉在地板上的硬币。

q: The café is on the first _____ you come to after the bridge.
translation: 咖啡馆就在你过桥后遇到的第一个弯道处。

q: His only form of _____ is playing football with his friends on weekends.
translation: 他唯一的消遣就是周末和朋友们一起踢足球。

q: The school offers several _____ programs for students during the summer.
explain: recreational adj. 娱乐的，休闲的。
translation: 学校在夏季为学生提供几个娱乐项目。

q: He paused for a moment, waiting for her to _____ the news.
explain: digest v. 消化；理解，领会。
translation: 他停顿了一会儿，等她慢慢领会这个消息。

q: She reads a monthly news _____ to keep up with current events.
translation: 她阅读一份每月新闻摘要来了解时事。

q: He tried to _____ me that my mother would be okay after the operation.
explain: reassure v. 使安心，打消……的疑虑。
translation: 他试图让我放心，说我母亲手术后会没事的。

q: The injured woman _____ to her feet and slowly left the room.
explain: stagger v. 蹒跚，摇晃着走。
translation: 那个受伤的女人摇摇晃晃地站起来，慢慢离开了房间。
